notes: Potentiometer straddles the breadboard centre gap: outer legs in bottom half columns 10 and 12 (row e), centre/wiper leg in top half column 11 (row g), as drawn in the circuit image.
Yellow wire end drawn at the pot's wiper pin; placed in 11t.h (same strip as the pot's wiper in 11t.g) so two parts do not occupy one hole.
Outer legs are interchangeable electrically; follows image: column 10 leg to GND (black), column 12 leg to 5V (red).
Black wire goes to the Uno GND pin on the power header (GND.1); red to 5V; yellow to A0.
Wire end holes 10b.d and 12b.d are in the same strips as the pot legs in 10b.e and 12b.e.
